en.headline: Visitor spends HK$10,000 McDonald's prize treating strangers
en.dek: A mainland tourist who won an Alipay voucher valid only in Hong Kong spent about a day buying meals for passers-by, cleaners and older diners before leaving the city.
body: A mainland visitor who drew a HK$10,000 McDonald's voucher through an Alipay promotion turned her last hours in Hong Kong into a running giveaway, according to accounts she posted on Xiaohongshu and subsequent local reporting.

The prize allowed up to 10 transactions of HK$1,000 each and could be used only at McDonald's stores in Hong Kong. She said gift cards at outlets had sold out and she was due to take a high-speed train home the next day, so she decided to treat strangers rather than leave the credit unused.

Stops described in her posts and in local coverage included Harbour Plaza and Chinachem Johnston Plaza in Wan Chai, Lockhart Road, Lan Kwai Fong and the Peking Road branch in Tsim Sha Tsui. She said she set aside about HK$2,000 for street cleaners and finished with meals for residents and older diners near Tsim Sha Tsui MTR. Alipay later publicly noted that she had passed the prize on to people she met.

zh.headline: 內地旅客抽中萬元麥當勞券請途人吃飯
zh.dek: 遊客透過支付寶抽中只限香港分店使用的一萬元優惠，離港前約24小時走訪灣仔及尖沙咀分店請客。
body: 一名內地訪港旅客透過支付寶活動抽中價值一萬港元的香港麥當勞優惠券後，在小紅書分享她離港前把額度用在途人、清潔工及長者身上，本地傳媒其後跟進報道。
獎券最多可用十次、每次上限一千元，且只限香港分店。她表示分店禮品卡已售罄，翌日又要乘高鐵返內地，於是決定親自請客，以免額度作廢。
帖文及後續報道提到她先後到灣仔輝盛閣、華懋莊士敦廣場、騖克道、蘭桂坊及尖沙咀北京道分店。她稱預留約兩千元給清潔工人，最後在尖沙咀站附近為市民及長者結帳。支付寶其後公開表示，大獎落在她手上，她把歡喜分給遇見的人。
